acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: A teenage girl finds a wallet and has to decide whether to return it. That, and other stories of people trying to do the right thing, and it not working out the way they thought.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
Rebecca Shrader thought she knew what was right when it came to abortion. Then she got pregnant. Reporter Emma Green tells the story.
Emma Green reported this story in collaboration for The Atlantic and its podcast, The Experiment.
acts.title: Damned If You Don't

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Brian and Peg disagree over a very important thing. Host Ira Glass tries to figure out who’s right.
acts.title: Brian and Peg

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Senior editor David Kestenbaum helps his kids set up an ant farm. They follow all the instructions, to the letter! But he ends up learning a lesson he’s pretty sure the manufacturer did not intend.
acts.title: Bought the Farm
